g.text: 1. Name the outcome in the panel title.
3. Average differences for the first n blocks.
The final planned sample is n = 10.
Each block contains 3 separate chain contexts.
More weeks or roles do not increase n.
This is a description of completed data,
not a rule for choosing a sample size.
How the estimated differences change as matched blocks are included
Each point uses the first n blocks in the fixed planned order. These are nested subsets of the same completed sample.
H1/H3: mean of 8 order-decrease / outstanding-increase probe slopes. H2: 24-week total holding + backlog cost.
H4a: mean within-role sample order variance. H4b: mean role order variance / final-consumer demand variance.
All panels report a difference between conditions, not an absolute performance level. Fictional student time framing.
